Hi Elena,

Thanks — attached are the documents you requested. Highlights below:

- Subprocessor list: attached CSV lists each vendor, primary function, jurisdiction, and whether they process Redwood customer data.
- SOC 2 Type II: we are happy to share a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary; our last external assessment completed 2025-03-18.
- Encryption & KMS: customer data at rest is AES-256 encrypted; key management is via customer-managed KMS for Private customers or Redwood KMS (GCP KMS/AWS KMS) for Hosted. Vivek is on the thread for any deeper tech questions.
- Notification cadence: Redwood notifies customers and relevant partners within 30 days when we add a subprocessor that materially affects data handling. We maintain a public list and versioned change log (link below).

Attachments:
- SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
- supplychain-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- vendor_questionnaire_answers.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Redwood-Security-Docs (redwood internal share; will convert to a vendor-view link on request)

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Grace,

Received the packet — thank you. A couple quick follow-ups:

1) Can you provide a short attestation that Redwood's public subprocessor list is the authoritative source and the process owner for updates? We usually ask for name and email of the team that owns notifications.
2) For the SOC2 summary, can you confirm whether the report includes encryption/crypto controls (CC6/CC7) and if any critical findings were reported in the last cycle?

If you can provide these two lines, that should be sufficient for our intake team to move to the next stage. We're targeting internal approval by 07/17.

Regards,
